messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — onboarding sampleapp failing when hitting embeddings + rerank. Node SDK response has a different key/shape than Python one so the retriever crashes.

marta: Repro: local sampleapp, batch size 8, node sdk 0.8.2 -> response body: 
```json
{"vectors": [[0.1,0.2,...,0.0], [...]], "meta": {"dim": 1536}}
```

marta: Python SDK 0.9.1 expects `embeddings` top-level and returns shape (8, 1536). Node returns `vectors` and an extra padding vec for some requests (length 9).

raj: ugh. can you paste the exact request body you sent? headers?

marta: Request: 
```http
POST /v1/embeddings?model=redwood-embed-small
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"input": ["a","b",...], "batching": {"max_tokens":1024}}
```

marta: Also seeing intermittent 401 from auth refresh, client retries and the batch helper appends a zero-vector on retry path. looks like dedupe logic missed the retry branch.

olivia: Hmm that sounds like two problems: a) key name parity (`embeddings` vs `vectors`) b) retry path adding padding. Are both in node sdk?

marta: Both observed in node. Py produces `embeddings` and no padding even when token refresh happens.

sam: Can repro locally with a small script. Minimal script attached: 
```js
const r = await client.embeddings.create({model:'redwood-embed-small', input:arr})
console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2))
```

raj: Possible quick fix: SDK should normalize response shape server-side or client-side. Devex guidance: always look for `embeddings || vectors` and normalize to `embeddings`. Also strip any trailing zero-only vectors if len(result) > request_count.

marta: Agreed. Also the batch helper's retry flow does `batch.push(zeroVec)` before re-dispatch — that's the bug.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-4821 — "node-sdk: embeddings key parity and retry padding causes extra vector" (assigned to olivia).

olivia: I'll take DEVEX-4821. Plan: 1) Add a response normalizer in node client that maps `vectors` -> `embeddings`. 2) Fix batch helper retry to snapshot batch and re-enqueue without mutating original array. 3) Add unit test that simulates auth refresh 401 + retry and asserts no extra vector appended.

sam: For short-term workaround in sampleapp: add a small adapter after response: 
```js
const out = res.embeddings || res.vectors || []
const normalized = out.slice(0, requestInputs.length)
```

raj: Also add log metric when response length !== input length so SRE can alert on OEM mismatch.

marta: I pushed a tiny patch to sampleapp to handle adapter, and added a failing test to capture padding. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/sampleapp/pull/232

olivia: Nice. I'll follow up with a node-sdk patch and release a patch version. Will update this thread with PR link.

marta: Thanks — leaving this here so others running into onboarding weirdness can find the workaround. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: DEVEX-4821 status: in progress (olivia).
